description: How I automated my content creation with Claude Code. One AI agent drafts every post, formats it for each platform, and stages it in Slack for one-click approval. Comment CONTENT for the full setup. #ClaudeCode #ClaudeAI #AIContentCreation
transcript: I've fully automated my content strategy utilizing Claude Code, and you can, too. Every single day, Claude goes out and researches a preset number of topics that I know I would talk about and y'all would find interesting. It then creates the captions and images for me, and also scripts for me to record and video, sends it to me in Slack, and from there I just send back approved or skip or no, and then it will post it directly to my platforms. Seven of them in total, 5 to six times a day. This just runs on autopilot. If you want to use this same exact agent and skill in your business with your content, comment the word content and I will send you the agent to build yourself.
